title: Money to place placed on two phones before they sync: the newer placing gives way (decision X5, confirm_review_1 item 5)
story: to_place.json's start: set up Mon 4 Jan 2027, the bank holds 150,000, of which 100,000 is kept for a trip and 20,000 is what is left of Free to spend (typed). Pay of 250,000 on the 25th (moved earlier); Free to spend is 40,000 a month. On Wed 6 Jan the trip is removed: its 100,000 is to place. On Thu 7 Jan, before the phones sync, both people place the trip's 100,000 in Free to spend: one at 12:00, the other at 12:03, each with an ordinary id. After the merge both records are there. X5 (P3 made general): every share-out from a limited amount is checked again after a merge; when two share more than there is, the newer gives way. Every amount is made up.

asks.question: headline
asks.why: 20,000 (Free to spend at the opening) + 100,000 (the trip's money placed in Free to spend at 12:00; the placing at 12:03 gave way, as only 100,000 was to place) = 120,000
asks.note: Before X5: 150,000 (the 100,000 placed twice, capped by the bank's headroom).

asks.question: safe_to_spend
asks.why: 150,000 (Bank today; nothing is left to place) = 150,000
